title: Annotatio III §.IX: Some require inserting causal ENIM (Matt. 26:28) under both Eucharist parts
pass_a_gloss: Some nevertheless contending for inserting into these words the Causative conjunction ENIM, found indeed at Matt. 26:28, and therefore to be understood nowhere not in the said words of either part of the Eucharist.
pass_b_english: Some insist on inserting the causative conjunction ENIM into those words.
It stands in Matt. 26:28, so they would have it understood under both Eucharist parts everywhere.
source_text: Contendentibus tamen nonnullis pro interferenda verbis hisce conjunctione Causativa, ENIM, quippe Matth. 26. 28. reperta, eoque nullibi non in dictis verbis utriusque partis Eucharistiæ subaudienda.

lemmas.gloss: of either part of the Eucharist
